meta.name: configuring-auto-scaling-policies
meta.description:
Configure use when you need to work with auto-scaling.
This skill provides auto-scaling configuration with comprehensive guidance and automation.
Trigger with phrases like "configure auto-scaling", "set up elastic scaling",
or "implement scaling".

copy.tagline: 配置云资源自动缩放策略，让资源随负载自动增减
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在管理需要根据负载自动调整规模的云服务
copy.tagline_en: Configure auto-scaling policies so cloud resources follow real-time demand
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage cloud services that need to adjust capacity automatically

howto.what: 根据你的目标(如 AWS 自动扩缩组、Kubernetes 部署等),生成弹性伸缩策略配置,包括最小/最大实例数、触发阈值、冷却时间,以及 Terraform、YAML 等格式的配置文件与监控告警。
howto.when: 当你说要配置自动扩缩、设置弹性伸缩或实施扩缩时触发;也可在处理自动扩缩策略时使用。

say.text: 为 GCP 实例组设置定时伸缩:早上 8 点 10 台,晚上 10 点 2 台。
say.note: 会生成对应的 GCP 伸缩配置。

howto.what_en: Generates auto-scaling policy configs for AWS/GCP/Azure/Kubernetes targets. Outputs Terraform HCL, HPA manifests, or CLI commands with instance limits, thresholds, cooldowns, and scale-in protection, plus monitoring alarms.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to configure auto-scaling, set up elastic scaling, or implement scaling, or when working with auto-scaling policies.

say_en.text: Configure AWS ASG: target tracking 65% CPU, min 2, max 20, cooldown 5 min.
say_en.note: Generates Terraform and CloudWatch alarm definitions.

say_en.text: Create a Kubernetes HPA scaling from 3 to 50 pods based on requests per second.
Set up scheduled scaling for a GCP MIG: 10 instances at 8am UTC, 2 at 10pm.
